description: Province and town names that changed in the corridor (Burundi 1962 and 2025, Rwanda 2006, DRC 1966-2015). Each change joins two Region nodes, old to new: renamed_to (same unit, new name), merged_into (the old unit is now part of a larger one; partial when only part of it went there), split_into (the old unit was divided); located_in (containment, not a change: Rwandan towns mostly kept their names in 2006 while their districts got new ones). Units carry other_names (Kinyarwanda names, colonial names, old spellings). Records and memories use old and new names side by side. continues_as: the same name carried on at another level (Bujumbura's 2010 urban communes are zones or quarters today).
